product_category.detail: Quick-service hamburgers, chicken sandwiches, fries, breakfast items, and drinks like lemonade and Coca-Cola.

market_position.detail: Quick-service burger chain with value deals and rewards offers; fresh beef positioning at affordable prices.

distribution_model.detail: Mostly franchised restaurants with drive-thru, plus some company-operated; delivery via third-party apps and own app.

purchase_frequency.detail: Repeat fast-food visits for breakfast, lunch, dinner; frequent but not daily staple.

notes: Market position and company-operated share draw partly on general knowledge of Wendy's; mass-market is a plausible alternative.
